title: 2026 Southwest Kansas GMD 3 Airborne Electromagnetic Survey — KGS/Aqua Geo Frameworks
description: Connector-disabled, noncanonical source-family candidate for the 2026 Southwest Kansas airborne electromagnetic (AEM) survey conducted by the Kansas Geological Survey (KGS), Groundwater Management District No. 3 (GMD 3), and Aqua Geo Frameworks. The survey is designed to map geologic structures affecting groundwater flow to approximately 1,600 feet below land surface. No official public flight-line, inversion volume, resistivity section/voxel, or interpreted hydrostratigraphic product has been admitted. Product availability remains UNKNOWN / NEEDS VERIFICATION. No connector activation, schedule, credential, release, or publication is authorized by this descriptor.
authority_notes: KGS and GMD 3 are the primary authority for the survey campaign identity, acquisition footprint, and any official processed or interpreted products. Aqua Geo Frameworks is the contracted acquisition and processing partner. Cross-domain consumers (geology and hydrology) must reference this single source identity rather than create duplicate source authorities.

admissibility_limits.limitations: A processed or interpreted AEM product must not rewrite the raw acquisition identity. A resistivity section, voxel, or interpreted hydrostratigraphic map is not a groundwater-level observation, water-right record, legal finding, recommendation, or release authority. The following stages are distinct and must not be interchanged: survey campaign, flight-line and acquisition segment, raw instrument observation, navigation/positioning, processing run and software version, inversion model/version, resistivity section or voxel, interpreted hydrostratigraphic unit, uncertainty/QC result, recommendation or management decision, released carrier and release decision. No product is asserted to exist until official bytes and source metadata are formally observed.
